surfaces.label: Installed desktop application
surfaces.boundary: The installed application owns runtime behavior, local data, native accessibility, and packaged-artifact proof.

surfaces.label: Landing, documentation, download, status, and settings site
surfaces.boundary: The site is a landing and documentation surface with local per-visitor equivalents; it is never the installed runtime.

responsiveContract.touchTargets: Every interactive target meets the supported platform minimum and has enough separation to avoid mis-taps.
responsiveContract.horizontalOverflow: The page body never scrolls sideways; wide tables, code, diagrams, and builders scroll inside their own bounded containers.
responsiveContract.viewportBoundedOverlays: Anchored menus, pickers, editors, and the command palette stay within the viewport, scroll internally, and never cover their opener.
